blocks.text: Computational thinking masla hal karne ka aisa tareeqa hai jis mein masle ko samjha jata hai, chhote hisson mein tora jata hai, aur logical soch se qadam ba qadam hal kiya jata hai.
Decomposition bare ya mushkil masle ko chhote aur sambhalne ke qabil (manageable) hisson mein torne ka amal hai.
Algorithm step-by-step hidayat (instructions) ka set hai jo masla hal karne ya koi kaam karne ke liye istemal hota hai.
Logic facts, statements aur qaidon ko baqaida (formal) tareeqe se likhne ka method hai, taake sahi reasoning aur sahi faisle ho sakein.
Proposition aisa statement hai jo ya sach ho ya jhoot, lekin ek hi waqt mein dono nahi.
Compound proposition do ya zyada simple propositions ko AND, OR aur NOT jaise logical operators se jor kar banta hai.
Truth table aisa table hai jo kisi logical expression ki truth values us ke inputs ke tamam mumkin combinations ke liye dikhata hai.
Propositional equivalence ka matlab hai ke do logical expressions ki truth values har mumkin soorat mein ek jaisi hon.
Proposition satisfiable hai agar kam az kam ek aisi soorat (condition) ho jis mein woh sach ho jaye.
Predicate logic logic ki aisi qism hai jo statements ko subjects (jin ki baat ho), properties, variables aur rishton se likhti hai.
Predicate aisa logical expression hai jo kisi subject ki property ya rishta bayan kare, jaise (Tall(Ali)).
Quantifier predicate logic mein yeh dikhata hai ke statement kitni cheezon par lagta hai, jaise for all (sab ke liye, ∀) ya there exists (koi ek maujood hai, ∃).
Logical inference diye gaye facts ya statements se sahi nateeja nikalne ka amal hai.
Deduction reasoning ka aisa tareeqa hai jis mein aam qaidon ya maloom facts se ek khaas nateeja nikala jata hai.

items: Propositional logic: proposition, connectives, truth table, equivalence, satisfiability.
Predicate logic: predicate, variables, quantifiers (∀, ∃), inference aur deduction.
